name: tenant-scope-check
description: Reads the SQL of a multi-tenant SaaS application that keeps every tenant in one shared database (the pool model), from one file, a folder, or the migrations and the query files together, and reports what could leak data across tenants: a SELECT, UPDATE or DELETE on a tenant table with no condition on the tenant column, a tenant table joined on a key alone, an INSERT that does not set the tenant column, a tenant table with no tenant column and a tenant column that leads no index. Allow markers with a reason, text, JSON and GitHub annotation output, exit codes for a pipeline, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
